# P31 Design System — Quantum Material (full)

> Neurodivergent-first, sovereign design system. Dark-first glass, OKLCH, spoon-aware.

## Design philosophy

- Quantum Material: 16px base unit, 863 Hz Larmor frequency. One base, one ratio, infinite scale.
- Perceptual color: OKLCH only. Hue+chroma fixed, lightness moves; light theme matches dark.
- Glass, not chrome: surfaces are translucent (4% white + blur), borders 8% white.
- Spoon-aware: at spoons 0-1, no motion, no blur, CrisisOverlay only.

## Components (32)

- **Badge** (badge, core) — Compact status label. Crisis mode keeps colors but forces opaque surfaces.
- **BottomNav** (bottom-nav, core) — Fixed bottom navigation bar for mobile-first apps. Use for primary app navigation.
- **Button** (btn, core) — Primary action button. Use for CTAs, form submissions, and key actions.
- **CalmIndicator** (calm-indicator, core) — Calm pill in the status cluster — reads spoon level and opens the calm overlay.
- **CalmOverlay** (calm-overlay, core) — Calm mode — the regulation instrument (CALM-MODE.md). Renders nothing; drives data-calm on <html> to hide chrome and keep the ambient. Store-agnostic — spoons/onExit are props.
- **CandyHeader** (candy-header, core) — Candy-rounded glass header for the sovereign stack.
- **Card** (card, core) — Elevated surface with an optional interactive affordance.
- **Chameleon** (chameleon, core) — Adaptive theme controls: brand × world × age × sensory modes. Zero-reload token swaps.
- **ChatShell** (chat-shell, core) — Conversational shell with a header, drawer, and chat surface.
- **Checkbox** (checkbox, core) — Tri-state checkbox (checked / unchecked / indeterminate).
- **CommandPalette** (cmdk, core) — Keyboard-friendly command palette (⌘K). Use for site-wide search and command invocation.
- **CommandTrigger** (command-trigger, core) — Topbar search affordance — a button with a keyboard hint that opens the command palette.
- **CrisisOverlay** (crisis-overlay, core) — Full-screen crisis mode overlay. Shown when spoons=0. Only exit control visible.
- **Crown** (crown, core) — Compact brand crown mark with a label.
- **Dropdown** (dropdown, core) — Selectable dropdown menu with options.
- **Footer** (site-footer, core) — Site footer with configurable columns, branding, and legal text.
- **GlassCard** (glass-card, core) — Padded glassmorphic card for content grouping. Use for feature cards, paper listings, and content tiles.
- **GlassPanel** (glass-panel, core) — Elevated glassmorphic surface with backdrop blur. Use for modals, drawers, and elevated content areas.
- **MetricBadge** (metric-badge, core) — Compact metric display with icon. Use for dashboard KPIs and telemetry.
- **MobileBottomNav** (mobile-bottom-nav, core) — Mobile bottom navigation bar — flagship items only (suite pattern). Store-agnostic.
- **ModePill** (mode-pill, core) — Primary mode control (SPARK / MAKER / WORKSHOP) with a tone dot.
- **NotificationStack** (notif-stack, core) — Stacked, severity-tinted notification toasts (bottom-right). Store-agnostic — items/onDismiss are props; colors via data-kind.
- **PageHeader** (page-header-route, core) — Inner-page hero: mono eyebrow, gradient title, and lede. Use at the top of content routes.
- **SectionStrip** (section-strip, core) — Desktop pill navigation strip. Use for primary section navigation on wide viewports.
- **SidebarNav** (sidebar-nav, core) — Flat suite navigation rail (emoji + label), active state per route. Store-agnostic — items/activePath/onNavigate are props.
- **SpoonCluster** (spoon-cluster, core) — Spoon dots in the status cluster — read-only metabolic status.
- **SpoonDial** (spoon-dial, core) — Cognitive load selector (0-5 spoons). Use for neurodivergent-first accessibility control.
- **Starfield** (starfield-bg, core) — Animated starfield background. Use for ambient backgrounds in shell and marketing.
- **StatusBadge** (badge, core) — Status indicator badge. Use for system status, health indicators, and state labels.
- **StatusCluster** (status-cluster, core) — Read-only status row in the topbar right region. Scrolls horizontally with edge fades when it outgrows the bar.
- **Topbar** (topbar, core) — Unified app-chrome shell — slot-based three-region layout. Brand / center / statusCluster / mode / trailing / identity, with variant (app|marketing|game) and mobile overrides. The identity slot is auth-agnostic (SignInLink / IdentityChip / AccountMenu fills).
- **TopbarSection** (topbar-section, core) — Vertically-centered, gap-consistent slot group inside a Topbar. Owns internal spacing; the Topbar owns arrangement.

## Token vocabulary

All visual values resolve to `p31.*` DTCG tokens. Key groups:

- `p31.color.*` — accent, text, status, action colors (OKLCH).
- `p31.glass.*` — glass surfaces and borders (alpha-tinted).
- `p31.surface.*` — the near-black void tiers.
- `p31.radius.*` — sm/md/lg/full radii.
- `p31.layout.spacing.*` — the 4/8/16/24/32 scale.
- `p31.font.family.*` — Space Grotesk / JetBrains Mono.
- `p31.z.*` — elevation (topbar, modal, crisis).

Resolve any token via the MCP tool `token_resolve(p31.color.accent.default)`.

## Rules (non-negotiable)

1. Every color resolves to a token. No hardcoded hex or raw rgba.
2. The shell owns geometry; the component owns appearance.
3. Themes are value swaps at the semantic tier, never component forks.
4. Crisis = no motion, no blur, CrisisOverlay only.
5. A missing token/component is a contribution proposal, not a workaround.
## Device tiers (manifest contract)

Manifest schema pointer: `production/design-workflow/B-device-tiers/device-tiers.json`
(v1.0.0). Per tier: `windowSizeClass`, `pointer`, `hover`, `touchTargetMin`,
`navigation`, `delivery[]`, plus tier-specific `breakpointMinDp`/`breakpointMaxDp`
(viewport tiers), `safeAreaInsets` (mobile/tablet), `assetsPartition: spiffs` +
`maxGzipBytes: 102400` (embedded), and a `rationale`. Breakpoints also exist as DTCG
dimension tokens (`breakpoints.tokens.json`): compact 600px/37.5rem, medium
840px/52.5rem, expanded 1200px/75rem.

| Tier | Class | Width (dp) | Pointer/hover | Touch floor | Navigation | Delivery |
|------|-------|-----------|----------------|-------------|------------|----------|
| embedded | null | — | null/null | 44 | minimal-html | embedded-css, lvgl-c |
| mobile | compact | < 600 | coarse/none | 44 | bottom-nav | css-mobile |
| tablet | medium | 600–840 | mixed/mixed | 44 | nav-rail | css-full |
| desktop | expanded | ≥ 840 | fine/hover | 34 (fine-only) | sidebar | css-full |

Embedded budgets (enforced by `D-embedded/embedded-budget.mjs`): served web UI
≤ 100 KB gzip total (`maxGzipBytes: 102400` — SPIFFS `assets` partition discipline;
current bundle 2,960 B gz); LVGL theme header `p31_theme.h` ≤ 8,192 B raw.

Tier doctrine: tiers are semantic value swaps, never component forks — the embedded
tier is a subset of the same DTCG tokens (`gen-p31-theme.mjs` → `p31_theme.h`),
fewer of them, never hand-forked. Capability flags (coarse/fine/canHover) are
independent axes, surfaced never collapsed: the resolver returns them alongside the
width class and consumers reconcile the 44px floor per capability; unknown
pointer/hover throws (fail closed).
